summary: Formats the championship score threshold for display: calls ChampionshipScoreThresholdSearch on the post-process input state base (dword_7C54E0) advanced by 13004 bytes; if the resulting threshold is positive it is rendered into the destination buffer as a decimal integer, otherwise a placeholder string (word_5C694C) is rendered instead. Always returns 0.

local_names.a1: destination buffer receiving the formatted string
local_names.v2: championship score threshold returned by ChampionshipScoreThresholdSearch

operations.description: Compute the threshold source pointer as dword_7C54E0 (post-process input state) + 13004 and pass it to the threshold search
Call ChampionshipScoreThresholdSearch on the derived source pointer to obtain the championship score threshold, stored in v2
Branch on whether the threshold v2 is greater than 0: format the integer on the positive path, the placeholder on the else path
Positive path: StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(a1, "%d", v2) renders the threshold as a decimal integer into the destination buffer
Else path: StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(a1, &word_5C694C) renders the placeholder string word_5C694C into the destination buffer
Reached from sub_49DE40 (0x0049DE40) as part of the championship score display path
